projects.title: Single letter · presence
projects.goal: Write one Arabic letter 10 times with calm breath; keep the best.
steps: Open Calligraphy lab card
Choose one letter (e.g. nun or alif)
Write slowly 10 times
Log which attempt felt most present

projects.title: One Beautiful Name
projects.goal: Calligraph or carefully write one Name of Allah; reflect one action.
steps: Pick one Name from reliable list
Write it with adab
Write one deed that Name inspires today

projects.title: Rule laboratory
projects.goal: Apply one tajweed rule to one ayah and self-review once.
steps: Open Tajweed booth
Select one rule (e.g. qalqalah)
Recite / listen once
Note one improvement

projects.title: Verified reminder card
projects.goal: Produce one media reminder with full source line; no mockery.
steps: Open Meme Studio
Use only Qur'an or authentic hadith text you verified
Add source reference on the card
Save for private notes until reviewed

projects.title: Three takeaways bench
projects.goal: Research with tools; leave with three takeaways + one teacher question.
steps: Open Deepen study
Read or watch one short reliable source
Write 3 takeaways
Write 1 question for a local teacher

projects.title: Prototype a lab exercise
projects.goal: Design a new educational lab module draft for librarian shelves (not auto-published).
steps: Name the exercise
State learner goal in one sentence
List 3-5 steps
Cite at least one authentic source URL from allowlist
Add safety note: educational only / ask teacher for rulings

projects.title: Phase craft path map
projects.goal: Map how calligraphy + tajweed + media serve sincerity, not performance.
steps: List one risk of craft without adab
List one safeguard
Propose one weekly lab rhythm (30-40 min)
